name: qlrisk_price_equity_trs
title: Price a EquityTRS
description:
Price one Equity Total Return Swap (TRS) (qlrisk EquityTRS).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, terms, payment_frequency=quarterly, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, is_receiver, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
